resources.string: Connect to my server
On your computer run dayhand pair and type the code it shows. The code works once, for 10 minutes.
Server address
The HTTP actions address, like https://name.convex.site
Pairing code
12 letters and digits, like ABCD-EFGH-JKMN
Connect
Connecting…
Connected. Syncing your tasks…
Enter the server address, starting with https://
A code has 12 letters and digits, like ABCD-EFGH-JKMN.
This code is wrong, already used or expired. Run dayhand pair for a new one.
Too many wrong codes. Try again later.

Connect to my server

Disconnect
Disconnect this phone?

Dayhand forgets the sign-in on this phone, which goes on with the plan on its own. Your tasks stay here, and changes not sent yet wait until you connect to this server again; connecting to another server replaces this plan. To also revoke the phone on the server, run: dayhand revoke %1$s
